notes.title: Improvement Update #21: Paludarium Inventory Table
notes.content:

notes.title: Improvement Update #17: Paludarium System
notes.content:
Hello, Aquascapers! 

In our latest update, we're thrilled to unveil the [b]Paludarium System[/b], a captivating addition to the Aquascapers universe. The Paludarium System brings a captivating twist to Aquascapers, offering players the opportunity to create unique aquatic landscapes in much larger fish tank. Players can dive into the Paludarium work process, which takes place in the expansion room adjacent to the main home base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/1fd07a67def5c81512cf88da3052bd5c640ba885.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/d66b592b4233e8a41219d9dbc3b113bc2d059fd1.png[/img]

While the Paludarium system shares similarities with the aquascape system, there are notable differences. One such distinction is the introduction of Paludarium special missions and unique paludarium items, particularly rocks and woods. To unlock the Paludarium system, players must first attain the [b]Level S License[/b] and [b]unlock the business expansion for Paludarium Business.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/7e1b1ca7b15c7ff514bcb668f61a6803054c9c3b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/e6367930a178a54469acdae9bd414bdb95c2386c.png[/img]

Once these prerequisites are met, players will receive a Paludarium mission email and they get permission to search for Paludarium-specific rocks and woods items in the wild. Unlike regular aquarium decorations, rocks and woods items are specially designed for arranging larger paludariums, adding an extra layer of depth and complexity to the landscape. These items can be collected from the wild, adding an exciting element of exploration to the gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/99969c829aafe0b2b5f4c1f04c852498ff99f18f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/90abbb1de8e8678f89e73a8d2c4f7bdf6455ea7c.png[/img]

In addition to rocks and woods, players can use the same plants and fish as those used in aquascaping to populate their paludariums. These items can be sourced from the wild or obtained through [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2299400/view/4178853497458427651]cultivation [/url]and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2299400/view/4178853497478629615]breeding[/url]. 

Upon completing their Paludarium, players can participate in auctions to sell their creations to fellow Paludarium enthusiasts. This interactive feature allows players to select from available auctions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/97d6d680a17890ad8b62cdc531c77dbb3bce0e45.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/d89bdadd0ff1a795ebf8f7cc6ba5b62851c01cf8.png[/img]

However, the challenge of making a paludarium lies in its scale and complexity, requiring players to hone their skills and creativity to overcome the obstacles. Despite the challenges, creating a paludarium offers a rewarding experience that can significantly improve players' skills and abilities in aquatic landscaping. Get ready to embark on this exciting journey and discover the endless possibilities of the Paludarium System in Aquascapers!

To access the latest enhancements, simply restart your Steam client or utilize the verify integration option in the game's properties. [b]Look out for the new version marked as v2024.18.4 [3bab3cd], visible in the bottom left corner of the main menu.[/b]

If you encounter any further issues or have additional feedback, please feel free to share them in the discussion.

Happy Aquascaping! 🌿🐠

notes.title: Improvement Update #14: Update on "Fish Breeding" Terms
notes.content:
In response to valuable feedback from our community, we're pleased to announce an important update to our game: the term "Fish Cultivation" has been officially changed to "[b]Fish Breeding[/b]." This update reflects our commitment to accuracy and authenticity in representing aquascaping practices.

Upon careful consideration and further research prompted by player input, we confirmed that "Fish Breeding" is indeed the more appropriate term for the process depicted in our game. As such, we have swiftly implemented this change to ensure alignment with industry standards and best practices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/a954690c8915a68243316dd13f9039f41d098500.png[/img]

This update underscores our dedication to customer collaboration in the development of our game products. We greatly value the insights and contributions of our players, recognizing their role in shaping the evolution of our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/5cb8e198c832bf46c79d3afdfcbdbffa0245d925.png[/img]

Moving forward, players can expect to see the term "Fish Breeding" used consistently throughout the game interface and accompanying documentation. We believe that this change will enhance the overall gaming experience and provide a more accurate portrayal of the aquascaping activities depicted in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/1dee57fc7d4c2a6d0e9f3c8b0d8f4c2caf967291.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/a7b3007ca622a50beefed8d683573b74b69d5bd8.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/08acaf3505253c2ef8202bab25fe00cd61f1fa87.png[/img]

As always, we remain open to further input and feedback from our community. Your insights are invaluable in driving continuous improvement and innovation in our game. Together, let's continue to cultivate an engaging and authentic gaming experience that resonates with aquascapers worldwide.

Thank you for your ongoing support, and happy Aquascaping! 🌿🐟

notes.title: Improvement Update #13: Road to Paludarium - Fish Cultivation
notes.content:
Hello, Aquascapers!

As we continue to expand and evolve our aquascaping ventures, we're excited to introduce the next stage of business development: [b]Fish Cultivation[/b]. This significant milestone follows the successful implementation of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2299400/view/4178853497460990729]Room Expansion[/url] and offers players the opportunity to unlock new possibilities within their aquascape business. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/af9d6320f5a991799a2515fd38e10afb0b1e820c.png[/img]

Fish Cultivation takes place within the expansion room, conveniently located adjacent to the main home base. Within this designated area, players will find five cultivation boxes designed to nurture fish from their juvenile stages to adulthood. This streamlined process eliminates the need for traditional fishing methods, allowing players to efficiently cultivate their desired fish species without the hassle of fishing in the wild.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/c5d241e4b352faac7a5d5d7484563ea81f32f919.png[/img]

One of the key benefits of fish cultivation is its efficiency. By cultivating fish, players can obtain their desired species reliably and save valuable time that would otherwise be spent fishing in various locations. Unlike traditional fishing, where multiple attempts may be required to capture specific species, fish cultivation provides a more direct and streamlined approach to acquiring aquatic companions for your aquascape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/73fc425d35e1745883ca1af8fafedea6d9ba89c0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/db04cd9afdf968e44dd0ad2f9dbdb767c852a634.png[/img]

While fish cultivation offers numerous advantages, it's essential to consider the limitations of traditional fishing methods. Fishing in the wild can be time-consuming and unpredictable, requiring players to invest significant effort in locating and capturing desired fish species. Additionally, identifying the correct fishing locations can pose a challenge, further complicating the process.

By embracing this feature, players can enhance their efficiency, streamline their operations, and unlock new opportunities for creativity and success in the world of aquascaping.

Prepare to immerse yourself in the captivating world of fish cultivation and elevate your aquascaping game to new heights. Happy aquascaping! 🐟✨

notes.title: Introducing Similarity Challenge in Higher Level License Projects
notes.content:

Today, we're thrilled to unveil an exciting addition to Aquascape Simulator's higher level license projects: the "[b]Similarity Challenge[/b]." As you progress through your aquascape journey, clients will task you with replicating specific target designs. However, before taking on these projects, a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2299400/announcements/detail/3654159407928174346]Project License must be purchased[/url] to validate your capabilities.

Now, let's dive into the details:
1. [b]Higher Level License Projects[/b]: At this stage, clients entrust you with their vision and expect you to recreate a specific aquascape design. These projects require a higher level of skill and attention to detail, challenging you to showcase your ability to mimic intricate designs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/878b7fd89324e5c12667d22fec6bd5513decc246.png[/img]

3. [b]Attention to Detail[/b]: Observe every detail in the target design, ensuring your creation mirrors the client's expectations. Focus on replicating specific plants, the layout of hardscapes, and the overall theme for the desired similarity.

4. [b]Valuation and Client Satisfaction[/b]:  Your design will be evaluated based on its proximity to the target design. The more closely you align your aquascape with the provided blueprint, the higher the valuation and client satisfaction you will receive. Strive for perfection to maximize your rewards.

This new similarity challenge adds a layer of realism and professional development to your aquascape journey. It tests your observational skills, attention to detail, and ability to recreate designs, allowing you to refine your expertise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/ef2daf61108dfc885ace78230d8ce271db91aee7.png[/img]

Happy aquascaping, and may you excel in the Similarity Challenge!

notes.title: Reviving Resources: A Deeper Dive into Respawn Mechanics in Aquascape Simulator
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/29e450154242ceb099ea1509e84879e036c499dd.png[/img]

Hello, Aquascapers!

In the latest version of Aquascape Simulator, we have implemented an exciting game mechanic to encourage exploration and discovery of new areas. We understand that the thrill of uncovering resources is an integral part of the gameplay experience. With our [b]Respawn Mechanic[/b], every item you gather will have the chance to reappear in the same location, allowing you to revisit previously explored areas and discover new gathering spots.

[h3]The Respawn Mechanic Explained[/h3]
Here's how it works: Once you've collected an item from a particular location, such as near a large tree, along the edge of a stream, or around a prominent rock, the item will temporarily disappear from that spot. However, it will eventually respawn after a certain period of time, giving you another opportunity to gather it.

[h3]Your Guide to Exploration: The Enviro Map Menu[/h3]
To aid you in your exploration, we have included the Enviro Map Menu. Within this menu, you can easily track the availability of items across various locations. The items that have not yet respawned will be marked with transparent icons, indicating that they are currently unavailable. This feature empowers you to plan your gathering expeditions, ensuring that you're always aware of the status of each item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/7e8204f9ca99a25098e78174c4d01e4e378463e2.png[/img]

By implementing this respawn mechanic, we aim to foster a sense of adventure and encourage players to explore different areas of the game world. As you traverse the lush landscapes, be sure to keep an eye out for new gathering spots and hidden gems that may have respawned since your last visit. Each location holds its own unique set of hardscapes, plants, and fish, waiting to be discovered and collected.

It simply means that the respawn timer has not yet elapsed. Take this opportunity to explore other areas, diversify your gathering locations, and expand your knowledge of the game world.

notes.title: Mission Challenges and Objectives in Aquascape Simulator
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/f07eb400b459a167052728ac483014f0329708d8.png[/img]

Hello, aquascapers!

In Aquascape Simulator, a multitude of missions await, each bearing distinct objectives that must be diligently pursued to attain specific goals. Much akin to the business model of real-world aquascaping, these missions can be classified into two primary categories: [b]project-based[/b] missions and [b]product-based[/b] missions.


[h2]Project-Based Mission[/h2]
Project-based missions task you with the creation of particular aquascapes, aligning with the specific requests of clients. These missions provide you with clear instructions and defined objectives to accomplish the desired outcome. Upon successful completion, you shall be rewarded with monetary compensation as recognition of your achievement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/3076f5653e10fdda7ae8b647fc65912a2d7e470c.png[/img]

[h2]Product-Based Mission[/h2]
In contrast, product-based missions grant you the creative liberty to conceive and design your aquascapes, which can then be presented for auction. Interested clients will submit their price offers, and as the entrepreneur, you have the privilege of selecting the most fitting bid.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/22facde6b5a7458a7a1f7b4811bf17ebd8250cd0.png[/img]

It's important to note that you can engage in only one mission at any given time. When you embark on a new mission, the previous one makes way for it, effectively replacing it. This means that simultaneous participation in two missions is not an option. Keep in mind that once replaced, the prior mission is no longer available for you to pursue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/885aa47502048f135dcf417b75d6ad0105a16d64.png[/img]

Each mission is accompanied by a set of objectives that must be met for its successful accomplishment. Typically, these objectives entail the possession and installation of specific items within the aquascape. In the event that the required items are absent from your inventory, you are tasked with sourcing them from external areas. Alternatively, you may opt to purchase these items from other players in the Global Shop. Keep in mind that the Global Shop feature remains locked and will only unlock after reaching a certain level within the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/99a2318312235f7095381ceb54afe33c5c4709f3.png[/img]

The inclusion of missions in Aquascape Simulator serves a dual purpose: to present engaging challenges and to fuel your motivation in building and managing aquariums. These missions teach you the art of resource organization and management within your aquatic haven, all while deepening your knowledge of diverse fish species and aquatic plants.

All in all, Aquascape Simulator's in-game missions and objectives play an important role in providing players with an enjoyable and educational gaming experience. Your input and active involvement significantly contribute to the continual evolution of Aquascape Simulator. notes.title: Exploring the Mountain Style in Aquascaping
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/5e84d7caa6dc832098315bc9b03180fa8b947752.png[/img]

[b]The Mountain Style[/b] in aquascaping offers a captivating portrayal of the natural allure of mountains, thoughtfully transposed into the confines of an aquarium. This style is characterized by a deliberate emphasis on incorporating boulders and lush greenery to artfully replicate the rugged charm of mountainous landscapes. Unlike some other styles, the Mountain Style places a premium on the abundant use of green plants over flowering varieties.

[h2]Characteristics[/h2]

[b]Majestic Rock Formations[/b]: At the heart of the Mountain Style lie the prominent use of substantial [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2299400/view/3675548970079963864]rocks[/url] that closely resemble rugged mountain terrain. These rocks are artfully arranged, typically with a focus on symmetry, to evoke a sense of natural harmony. To infuse authenticity, greenery, especially vine-like plants like Moss, is often used to envelop the rocks, enhancing the overall natural aesthetic. Additionally, the inclusion of spruce and dwarf trees further enhances this style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/8a905829a24ef73ab0d869eea7bc785c14b15dff.jpg[/img]

[b]Structured Composition[/b]: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2299400/view/3675548970079028882]Compositions [/url]within the Mountain Style typically follow a three-tiered structure. The front section of the aquarium is planted with low-profile vegetation, while the central portion is adorned with substantial stones enveloped in greenery. The rear section is dedicated to taller greenery, creating depth and dimension.

[b]Plant Care[/b]: Maintaining the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2299400/view/3654159407926889168]greenery [/url]in the Mountain Style is relatively straightforward. Adequate lighting, a stable water temperature, and regular maintenance tasks such as pruning and fertilization are essential to sustain robust plant growth.

[b]Fish Selection[/b]: When selecting fish for this style, opt for species with neutral coloration, such as cardinal fish or neon fish. These fish provide a subtle splash of color without overpowering the overall aesthetic. However, it's advisable to avoid excessively populous or large fish, as they can disrupt the carefully cultivated ambiance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/b7feef6f2aa6800bcabd4d21fdb562ea2a8327ce.jpg[/img]

[b]Composition Considerations[/b]: Crafting a Mountain Style composition requires thoughtful consideration of rock size and shape, as well as plant selection. Striking the right balance in the size ratio of rocks to plants is pivotal to avoid an overcrowded or barren appearance.

In summary, the Mountain Style in aquascaping allows for the creation of a captivating and visually striking aquarium, featuring meticulously crafted mountain-inspired elements.

notes.title: The Jungle Style: Bringing Nature into Aquascaping
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/12f387868b3b9dd01fb887eab212ace47c0ccb26.jpg[/img]

The Jungle style in aquascaping seeks to recreate the ambiance of a tropical forest within an aquarium. This style is lauded for its lush, densely packed vegetation that mimics the complexity of a real forest. An aquascape designed in the Jungle style aims to transport you into a natural world, as if a piece of the jungle has been encapsulated in your aquarium.

[h2]Characteristic[/h2] 

Here are some characteristics of the jungle style in Aquascape:

[b]Dense plants:[/b] The Jungle style is all about embracing the sheer diversity of plant life. Achieving the impression of a dense forest necessitates the use of various plant species. Typically, plants with wide leaves take precedence in this style.

[b]Wood and Stone Roots:[/b] While plants are at the forefront of the Jungle style, the use of wood and stone roots is vital to maintain the authentic feel of a tropical forest. These materials are typically chosen for their natural, rough textures and varied appearances.

notes.content:

Hello, Aquascapers!

Aquascaping is about blending hardscape, plants, and fish into captivating water gardens. A pivotal aspect is choosing fish that balance the ecosystem and visual appeal. Here, we share tips on fish selection and care for your aquascape.


[h3]1. Choose Fisth that Fit the Size of the Aquarium[/h3]

Before welcoming any fish into your tank, acquaint yourself with their mature size. This understanding ensures they won't feel cramped, allowing them to navigate the aquarium freely. Oversized fish can disrupt the harmony, so choose wisely to maintain a balanced aquatic environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/06cb1bbcbb70239dad3cb273cd55502e5bfc5232.jpg[/img]

[h2]2. Choose Fish According to the pH and Temperature of the Water[/h2]

Each type of fish has a different preference for water pH and temperature. Make sure to choose fish according to the water conditions in the tank. Consult with an aquarium expert or fish store to find out which type of fish is right for your tank.

[h2]3. Nutritional Harmony [/h2]
Different fish types have distinct nutritional demands linked to their diets. To foster their well-being, provide appropriate sustenance that caters to their dietary requirements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/091a110a65503b3d7308ac6ea329c7dc9d667598.jpg[/img]

[h2]4. Avoid Aggressive Fish[/h2]

Aggressive fish can disrupt the tranquility of the tank and distress fellow inhabitants. Opt for amiable species that coexist harmoniously, factoring in the existing fish community. Especially in smaller tanks, it's wise to avoid excessively large or aggressive species.

[h2]5. Avoid Fish that are Easily Stressed[/h2]

Certain fish exhibit heightened sensitivity to environmental changes, causing them undue stress. Prioritize stress-resilient fish accustomed to aquarium conditions. Neon fish and guppies stand as examples of such resilient choices.

[h2]6. Do Regular Maintenance[/h2]

Sustaining thriving fish requires consistent maintenance. Regularly cleanse the aquarium and administer routine water changes. Additionally, ensure a balanced and nutritious diet to ensure their vitality.

In selecting and maintaining fish for an aquascape, keep in mind that fish are an important element that plays a role in creating an ecosystem balance in the aquarium.
